name: Broan 7 Inch Round Damper with Foam for Range Hoods
Broan 893901 39" Range Hood
description: When You Need Cleaner Kitchen Air, You Can Rely on the Broan 39" White Range Hood The Broan 39" White Range Hood is a deluxe under-cabinet hood that will remove smoke, grease and odors from your kitchen air. Heat Sentry will automatically activate the blower when it detects too much heat in the room. Use the front slide control can to adjust the fan speed, or use the blower memory feature that saves the last-used setting. Besides offering a powerful fan, this Broan 39" Range Hood also has a built-in lamp with two settings: bright or nightlight. The hemmed bottom and mitered sides not only add safety and durability, but also make it easy to clean and add a stylish look.

name: Broan 37000 Series 24 in. Range Hood Shell Only in White
description: Help protect your cabinets from stove flare-ups with the Broan 37000 Series 24 in. Range Hood Shell Only in White. Featuring durable steel construction, this range hood shell uses the 40000 series shell but has no fan, light, switches or knockouts for electrical wiring or ducting. The hood is primarily used for HUD-qualified housing.
